patch_description: Reorganizes the search around a compact scored archive and a modular operator portfolio. Each operator proposes its own neighborhood; a smoothed success-rate model allocates LP trials among bottleneck-focused switches, exploratory switches, rotations, kicks, and consensus-guided moves. Candidate ranking is cached, and each batch keeps some top-ranked proposals while preserving structural diversity. This avoids rebuilding and broadly screening large mixed neighborhoods every round, while retaining multiple ways to escape local minima.
